subject: Scissor-lift manufacture-year identification
summary: One manufacturer-documented serial date layout; plate-based or manufacturer-confirmed dating for other covered units. No universal decoder verified for all four brands.

models: S3370RT example; other Snorkel units only where the same documented serial layout is established
rules.region: Manufacturer article includes UK, USA, New Zealand and China plant codes
rules.serial_scope: MODEL-PP-YYMMNNNNN example layout; legacy applicability and adoption date unspecified
rules.rule: The four-digit date segment is YYMM. Published example S3370RT-07-170300298 maps 1703 to March 2017; 00298 is the unit sequence.
rules.automatic_year_assignment: Only after exact format/model match and unambiguous century; compare with plate date.
rules.limitations: Do not apply to numeric-only/other legacy serials or UpRight. Prose mentions three dashes, but its printed example contains two. No general start/end-year table is supplied.

rules.serial_scope: Exact model location must be checked
rules.rule: Read the explicit manufacture-date field. General plate location: slab scissors below entry doors/behind steps; rough-terrain scissors on cabinet near ground controls.
rules.limitations: Do not substitute warranty, shipping, inspection or manual dates.

rules.region: English manufacturer manual; distributor index describes ANSI and CE
rules.serial_scope: Boundary disputed: index/filename 51119+ versus visible cover 5119+
rules.rule: Plate is at rear of chassis. Backup serial stamp is on chassis top above front axle pivot. Obtain exact model and serial, then request date evidence through successor support if the plate lacks a usable date.
rules.limitations: Image review confirms a source conflict, not just OCR. Do not silently correct the cover or map Feb10 to machine year. No universal decoder verified.

rules.serial_scope: See separate manual-applicability records; preserve index/cover differences
rules.rule: MFG DATE records manufacture month/year. MODEL YEAR is a separate machine-model-year value. Store both independently if visible.
rules.automatic_year_assignment: From legible plate data, not a serial prefix.
rules.limitations: Serial ranges select manuals; they are not annual production ranges. A 2016 manual date does not date every covered machine.

rules.rule: Read MFG DATE on the original serial plate.
rules.limitations: Keep serials 18000000-18000018 unresolved for this manual. March 2025 is its revision, not unit year; first two serial digits are not verified as year.

rules.serial_scope: Current index routes 16900000-16910999 to 94553-A92.6; 16911000+ to newer manual
rules.rule: MFG DATE and MODEL YEAR are distinct fields on the serial plate.
rules.limitations: September 2017 is publication metadata. The 169 prefix is not established as a manufacture-year code.

rules.serial_scope: Exact model and full serial required
rules.rule: Select the exact model/serial manual first; ask MEC Product Support for manufacture-date confirmation when no plate date survives. The official index lists Product Support at +1 559 710 2373.
rules.limitations: No public serial-to-year response or universal formula was verified. No contact was made.

rules.serial_scope: No serial applicability boundary established in this edition
rules.rule: Read YEAR OF MANUFACTURE on the machine plate. This edition locates the plate at the back-right of the chassis and instructs users to identify the machine by type and serial.
rules.limitations: October 2005 is the manual issue date. Do not extend its location or specification details to the 2022 redesigned Compact family without checking that family manual.

models: Haulotte models supported by ETI Lite
rules.serial_scope: Full serial or exact model; QR label can direct to relevant library
rules.rule: Use https://www.haulotte-service.com/Front-ETI/en to locate matching operator, service and parts documents. Machine QR labels are near lower controls and in manuals.
rules.limitations: Portal shell and official documentation were verified; a returned manufacture date was not. Serial lookup of documents is not proof that a year decoder exists.

rules.serial_scope: 2089762 appears in title, not in a separately labeled serial field
rules.rule: The manufacturer used-equipment listing states manufacture year 2021 for this titled unit.
rules.limitations: Not a verified decoder record. Confirm identifier from original plate or explicit factory record. Never interpolate annual ranges from isolated advertisements.

guardrails: Never infer a unit year from manual issue/revision/upload dates.
Store manufacture_year separately from model_year, first_sale_year, model_launch_year and warranty_start_date.
Do not treat manual serial breaks as annual production breaks.
Match brand, model, serial layout and market/standard before using a rule.
Preserve unresolved source conflicts; retain null rather than force a year.
No manufacturer outreach, login, account creation or production-data changes occurred in this research.
